prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: transparent PNG sprite sheet of TEN isolated game category doodles for website cards.
Input image 1 is style reference only. Match the playful thick slightly imperfect black hand-ink outlines, offwhite filled paper shapes, light pencil texture, pale yellow and lavender accent colors of its card illustrations. Do not reproduce its UI.
Request: A clean strict 5-column by 2-row grid. Exactly ten separate complete doodle illustrations. Each grid cell has exactly equal width and height. Keep every drawing entirely within its own cell with generous transparent gutters and safety margins, no adjacent illustration overlapping. Each doodle same visual size and complexity. All are readable small icons, upright or lightly tilted as in reference. Genuine transparent RGBA background.
Top row LEFT TO RIGHT:
1. Cinema: black and offwhite movie clapperboard with a little round film reel beside it.
2. TV series: small old-fashioned television screen with two antenna rods, pale lavender screen, rounded offwhite case.
3. Anime: charming original cute cat-like face with pointed ears, big starry eyes and a smile, pale yellow and offwhite; no existing trademarked character.
4. Video games: chunky offwhite game controller, black outlined buttons and cross direction pad, lavender buttons.
5. Cities: tiny group of city buildings with simple windows and a yellow map-location pin.
Bottom row LEFT TO RIGHT:
6. Music: black and offwhite over-ear headphones leaning against a small black vinyl record with yellow center.
7. Medical diagnosis: black outlined stethoscope draped around a small offwhite medical clipboard with a simple lavender medical plus and a few black chart lines. No lettering.
8. Animals: cute friendly fox or cat face and a small paw print, yellow and offwhite with black ink.
9. Books: one open offwhite book resting on two closed lavender/yellow books.
10. Characters: two overlapping little rounded portrait cards, one shows a simple generic cartoon person's head, the other a large handwritten question mark.
Palette only ink black, warm offwhite, soft golden yellow, pale lavender; transparent outside objects. Thick hand-drawn marker contours, handmade editorial doodle look matching reference. No full backgrounds or cell boundaries, no labels or readable words, no page UI, no watermarks. Exact 5 columns and 2 rows, equal cells with wide gutters. Every shape fully visible.
